comment: The link and track jacks exclusive-or with their buttons rather than overriding them (StepWave.cpp:431, StepWave.cpp:448), so a high gate inverts whatever the button is set to. The stage value inputs are normalled left to right and so are the displacement inputs, each falling back to the nearest patched jack before it (StepWave.cpp:492, StepWave.cpp:475). The module runs two copies of the sequencer, one of them a beat ahead for the display, and only the second writes the output jacks (StepWave.cpp:930). It switches itself to an oversampled output path whenever the measured beat is shorter than 50ms (StepWave.cpp:400), which also turns off the panel lamps.
